A '''bunker-buster''' was a weapon used to penetrate fortified structures.

==History==
During the [[Taris Siege]] in the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]' invasion force used Bunker-Busters to penetrate the lower levels of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

[[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] carried bunker-busters for assaults on hardened targets. They were one of three types of standard-issue ammunition provided to the AAT<ref name="CSS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>.

Bunker-busters were also used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troops]] used them to [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|penetrate and enter]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's]] [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] during the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] incident.<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>
